title: Ethium's Delight
description: Adds an Ethium Knife for Farmer's Delight
body:
![Ethium knife on a cutting board](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/SdefJ9jr/images/5618c881b636f4bc2ef06e4922cc6512f3e234b7.png)
A very simple mod that adds an Ethium Knife so your knife collection can finally be complete, assuming you're using [Ethium Reimagined](https://modrinth.com/mod/ethium), of course. A Discord Server member requested this feature, so if _you_ have any ideas, feel free to suggest them!
